test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Four of the following five are alike in a certain way and hence form a group. Which is the one that does not belong to that group?

A. FHJL

B. KMOQ

C. PRTV

D. ACED

E. WYAC
solution:
The letter cluster that does not belong to the group is ACED.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

The logic is based on the position of the letters in the English alphabet. Four of the clusters have a consistent pattern, while one does not.

Option 1) ACED

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1bfb6b0f3df5f8a1c333ddbfde89558d3077c80197728431a22392afc06574a2.png] 

Option 2) **FHJL**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db918ce9dd8410f57df2ab14bb04bc1550de9718a81ebcc90cbcad4b051ea3ad.png] 

 

Option 3) **PRTV**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34612a858891136ca94f50df7e437786824c117cf8e2e8757a46f725325dd95c.png] 

Option 4) KMOQ

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ef066deb1bf12f8d478bfd5d329df7fb0f23509109a2ca8b53c860865502576c.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 1".**
